issues.detail: The Hebrew 'קְטֹרֶת' means 'incense', not '乳香' (frankincense). Frankincense is 'לְבוֹנָה' in Hebrew. This changes the substance offered.

The Hebrew 'לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם' means 'for your generations' (i.e., throughout your generations), but the Chinese renders it as '作為你們世代的面' ('as the face of your generations'), which is a mistranslation. The word 'פָּנִים' (face) is not in the Hebrew here; the Hebrew has 'לִפְנֵי יְהוָה' ('before the LORD') earlier, but the final phrase is simply 'for your generations'.
